summary: E2E test of AdminTrips form + public detail + Home featured. Created TEST_Viaje_Auto with 3 pricing tiers (Campamento 3900, Cabaña 4900, Hotel 5900) via admin UI, dates 2026-02-05..2026-02-08, transport/lodging texts, Featured+Active. Verified: (1) no 'Días' field in form, no 'Días' column in admin table; (2) backend stored duration_days=4 auto-calculated, price=3900 (min tier), 3 pricing_tiers, included_transport/included_lodging as entered, featured=true; (3) public /destinos/:id shows all 3 tier labels and prices in 'Costo por viajero', hero 'desde $3,900', ¿Qué incluye? Transporte/Hospedaje cards render captured texts; (4) Home 'Próximos destinos' shows TEST trip at position 0 (soonest date 2026-02-05); (5) edit removed Hotel tier and public detail updates ($5,900 no longer visible, 2 tiers remain); (6) delete removed trip (GET returns 404). Catalog restored to original 10 trips.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor observation (not in scope): after navigating from /admin to /destinos/:id and back to /admin, the AdminDashboard shows the login screen again. Auth token is stored in localStorage (not the httpOnly cookie) and may be lost/read incorrectly on remount. Non-blocking, but worth verifying in AdminDashboard.jsx auth-guard.

AdminTrips.jsx still exposes 'Precio base (desde)' input in the form; when tiers are provided it is ignored (recomputed to min tier). Consider hiding/disabling this input when tiers.length>0 to avoid admin confusion (current behavior is correct, just UX).
seed_data_creation: None retained. TEST_Viaje_Auto created & fully deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 requested feature areas verified end-to-end (pricing_tiers, no Días field, included_transport/included_lodging on detail, featured ordering on Home). Cleanup verified via API 404. Only side observation: admin session appears to be lost after visiting public routes; if reported in the future, inspect AdminDashboard auth-guard (localStorage token handling).
